name: harness-platform
description: Harness inside Claude Code: CI/CD, deployments, approvals, GitOps, security, feature flags, incidents, cost and every other Harness module, in one pane, with guardrails for Claude

api_key.title: Harness API key
api_key.description: PAT or service-account token with read access. Leave empty to sign in with Harness instead: /mcp → plugin:harness-platform:harness → Authenticate

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Leave empty to read it from the API key

base_url.title: Harness URL
base_url.description: e.g. https://app.harness.io (or your SMP / regional URL)

repo_name.title: Repo name override
repo_name.description: Match runs to this repo name instead of the git origin of the current directory

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to refresh (10s while watching a push)

max_runs.title: Runs to fetch
max_runs.description: Recent executions to fetch per refresh

auto_open.title: Open pane at start
auto_open.description: Open the Harness pane when a session starts (needs a wide terminal)

skip_user_lookup.title: Skip user lookup
skip_user_lookup.description: Don't call currentUser (use with service-account keys)

on_failure.title: When your commit fails
on_failure.description: notify: toast only · ask: offer to let Claude fix it · auto: Claude fixes and pushes again, up to the attempt limit

auto_fix_attempts.title: Auto-fix attempts
auto_fix_attempts.description: Most fix-and-push attempts per pipeline before handing back to you (on_failure: auto)

push_guard.title: Pushing while red
push_guard.description: hold: ask before Claude pushes onto a failing build · warn: toast and push · off

prod_guard.title: Confirm production actions
prod_guard.description: Always ask before Claude runs a Harness write action (execute/create/update/delete) that targets production

diagnose.title: Failure diagnosis
diagnose.description: auto: diagnose failures as they appear · on_demand: only when you press diagnose · off. Uses a small model on your plan

add_context.title: Add Harness context to prompts
add_context.description: On prompts about builds, deploys or releases, add one line of current Harness state for Claude

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: stacked · focus (branch-first) · dock (sidebar in wide fullscreen terminals) · strip (band only; pane opens when something fails). Press v in the pane to switch

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: One line with your commit, a sparkline of recent runs and prod lag

allow_actions.title: Allow write actions
allow_actions.description: Retry, rerun, abort, approve and reject from the pane. Each asks first; production asks twice

mcp_server.title: Harness MCP server (sign-in mode)
mcp_server.description: Harness MCP server to use, as /mcp lists it. Empty: plugin:harness-platform:harness-local with an API key, plugin:harness-platform:harness when signed in

inventory_days.title: Inventory history (days)
inventory_days.description: How far back the deployment inventory looks for each service's live version

inventory_max_runs.title: Inventory runs to scan
inventory_max_runs.description: Upper bound of CD runs read per inventory scan (100 per request)

modules.title: Platform modules
modules.description: Modules to show: gitops, security, supply_chain, flags, alerts, incidents, registry, releases, policies, iacm, catalog, cost, database, chaos

module_attention.title: Platform attention line
module_attention.description: Refresh modules in the background and show what needs attention (failing GitOps apps, critical security issues, open alerts…)

start_view.title: Starting screen
start_view.description: What the pane opens on: home (suggestions and every view), runs (your change), inventory (deployments), approvals, service, or platform. You can also press s in any view
